purpose: Prove a bounded implementation behavior with an independent executable oracle before and after the smallest admitted change.

applicability.when: A focused executable oracle exists and pre-change behavior can be evaluated.
A bounded implementation target has admitted edit authority and the same oracle can verify it afterward.
Regression protection can remain after the change.

non_applicability.when: Work is investigation-only or diagnosis lacks repair authority.
Work is architecture or design only.
No executable oracle exists or verification is unsafe or unavailable.
Behavior is already satisfied, so pre-change unmet evidence cannot be established.

stages.objective: Use the supplied focused oracle to prove the bounded behavior is unmet before mutation.
Make only the smallest admitted implementation change.
Run the same oracle and prove the desired behavior.
Return evidence and stop once sufficient.

acceptance.condition: A specific observable behavior is bounded.
A focused executable oracle remains independent of the implementation change.
The oracle proves unmet behavior before mutation.
Only admitted implementation source changes after RED.
The same oracle proves desired behavior after mutation.
The oracle remains present and valid.
No unrelated work follows sufficient evidence.

failure_conditions.condition: The initial focused oracle passes or is unavailable.
The post-change oracle does not pass.

stop_conditions.condition: RED, bounded change, GREEN, and durable oracle evidence are retained.
